entries.decision: Decorate only an actual Common V1.0 XSD INVALID result where both DataAcceptedResponse choice branches are present.
guards: official Common V1.0 strict profile only
both exact branches must be present
must not reinterpret xs:choice as sequence

entries.decision: Allow the XSD-valid empty ServiceSpecificationWithStateList and optionally explain the stricter PDF 1:* statement.
guards: official Common V1.0 strict profile only
list must be present and contain zero ServiceSpecificationWithState children
must not reject an XSD-valid empty list

entries.decision: Decorate only an actual Common V1.0 XSD INVALID result caused by a second Announcement or second FareZone in JourneyStopInformation.
guards: official Common V1.0 strict profile only
exact repeated element must be Announcement or FareZone

entries.decision: Decorate only an actual Common V1.0 XSD INVALID result caused by the exact PDF-derived child name ShortTripStopList where the selected XSD expects ShortTripStop.
guards: official Common V1.0 strict profile only
must not register ShortTripStopList as alias
must not invent a type-shape runtime difference because the two compared XSD structures are instance-shape equivalent
